crossRefs.note: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children…
Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of…
The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of…
Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because Yahweh has looked at my affliction…
Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a son.
Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.
“Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.
Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near…
They passed over the Jordan, and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley…
For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice…
Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and…
Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.
Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before Yahweh…
So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one other.
They also said to Pharaoh, “We have come to live as foreigners in the land, for there is no pasture for your servants’…
I will bring Israel again to his pasture, and he will feed on Carmel and Bashan. His soul will be satisfied on the…
Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest, in the middle of…
For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, isn’t the Father’s…

people.name: Gad
people.line: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Jazer
people.line: A town in Gilead, allotted to Gad

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead. Behold, the place was a place for livestock.
translations.bsb: Now the Reubenites and Gadites, who had very large herds and flocks, surveyed the lands of Jazer and Gilead, and they saw that the region was suitable for livestock.
translations.kjv: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
